Construct DoubleQuota(x:Int64,y:Int64,cap:Int64)->Int64. Ordered checks: x<=cap (FIRST_CAP, site x, label g1), then y<=cap (SECOND_CAP, site y, label g2). Return x+x+y using checked signed64 addition. CallerA reads x then y as UInt8 (read_x/read_y), checks end-of-input (input_end) BEFORE computation, composes (call) with cap=170, adds 6 and returns Int64 encoded UInt16BE. CallerB reads x as UInt8 (read_x), checks end-of-input (input_end) BEFORE computation, derives y=x+11, composes (call) with cap=170 and returns unchanged. Admit reusable definition then two dependent callers. Retrieve and validate both, execute representative inputs. All definitions revision1. Stop after base stage. No successor yet.
